title: The real cost of running AI models that nobody talks about

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Did you know AI models can use as much energy as a small town?

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This matters because AI is everywhere — from your phone to your car.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Running these models costs billions in electricity every year.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Some models use as much power as 100,000 homes in a single day.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: This affects companies and consumers, raising costs and carbon footprints.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: The real cost isn’t just money — it’s environmental impact we’re ignoring.

lines.speaker: Nova
lines.text: Want to know how to cut AI’s energy use in half? Follow for the fix.
